details.biography:
Jeremy Slater is an American writer and producer of film and television. He is known for his work on films such as Fantastic Four, Death Note, and Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire and television series such as The Umbrella Academy and The Exorcist, which Slater created and on which he served as executive producer. He was the head writer and executive producer for the Disney+ miniseries Moon Knight.
